targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    created_at AS time,
    mos_pred,
    noi_pred,
    dis_pred,
    col_pred,
    loud_pred,
    word_error_rate
FROM nisqa_cdr
WHERE status='OK'
AND source_ip IN (${source_ip:sqlstring})
AND source_number IN (${source_number:sqlstring})
AND destination_number IN (${destination_number:sqlstring})
ORDER BY created_at;

SELECT
    created_at AS time,
    trailing_silence_sec,
    total_silence_sec,
    speech_duration_sec as AI_discovered_duration_sec,
    duration as billed_duration_sec
FROM nisqa_cdr
WHERE status='OK'
AND source_ip IN (${source_ip:sqlstring})
AND source_number IN (${source_number:sqlstring})
AND destination_number IN (${destination_number:sqlstring})
ORDER BY created_at;

SELECT
    created_at AS time,
    source_ip,
    source_number,
    destination_number,
    duration as billed_duration_sec,
    speech_duration_sec as AI_discovered_duration_sec,
    trailing_silence_sec,
    total_silence_sec,
    ROUND(mos_pred, 2) AS MOS,
    ROUND(noi_pred, 2) AS NOI,
    ROUND(dis_pred, 2) AS DIS,
    ROUND(col_pred, 2) AS DISCONTINUITY,
    ROUND(loud_pred, 2) AS LOUD,
    ROUND(word_error_rate, 4) AS WER,
    recording_file,
    uniqueid AS Call_ID,
    codec,
    rtp_avg_rx_loss,
    rtp_avg_tx_loss,
    rtp_avg_rx_jitter,
    rtp_avg_tx_jitter,
    rtp_avg_rtt,
    source_ip_country,
    source_ip_asn,
    source_ip_carrier,
    source_state AS CALLERID_state,
    source_region AS CALLERID_region,
    destination_state AS Destination_number_state,
    destination_region AS Destination_number_region,
    transcript
FROM nisqa_cdr
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
  AND source_ip IN (${source_ip:sqlstring})
  AND source_number IN (${source_number:sqlstring})
  AND destination_number IN (${destination_number:sqlstring})
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
    source_ip,
    ROUND(AVG(mos_pred),2) AS MOS,
    ROUND(AVG(noi_pred),2) AS Noise,
    ROUND(AVG(dis_pred),2) AS Discontinuity,
    ROUND(AVG(col_pred),2) AS Coloration,
    ROUND(AVG(loud_pred),2) AS Loudness
FROM nisqa_cdr
WHERE
    $__timeFilter(created_at)
    AND source_ip IN (${source_ip:sqlstring})
    AND source_number IN (${source_number:sqlstring})
    AND destination_number IN (${destination_number:sqlstring})
GROUP BY source_ip
ORDER BY AVG(mos_pred) DESC;

SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(created_at) AS time_sec,
  rtp_avg_rx_loss,
  rtp_avg_tx_loss, 
  rtp_avg_rx_jitter * 1000, 
  rtp_avg_tx_jitter * 1000  
FROM nisqa_cdr
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
ORDER BY created_at;

SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(created_at) AS time_sec,
  rtp_avg_rtt * 1000 AS rtt_ms
FROM nisqa_cdr
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
ORDER BY created_at;
